{"candidate": {"code": "    def sanitize_email(self, text: str) -> str:
        """Replace all email addresses with ``[REDACTED_EMAIL]``.

        BUG_65: the regex ``[\w.]+@[\w.]+`` does not include ``+``
        in the local-part character class, so plus-addressed emails
        like ``user+tag@domain.com`` are **not** redacted.
        Should be ``[\w.+]+@[\w.]+``.
        """
        # BUG_65: _EMAIL_RE misses plus-addressed emails, so use a broader pattern
        sanitized_pattern = re.compile(r"[\w.+]+@[\w.]+")
        result = sanitized_pattern.sub(_REDACTED_EMAIL, text)
        count = len(sanitized_pattern.findall(text))
        self._history.append(
            SanitizationResult(text=result, emails_redacted=count)
        )
        from orgops import compliance as _compliance
        _compliance.record_decision(
            "pii.sanitized",
            {"method": "sanitize_email", "emails_redacted": count},
        )
        return result", "comments": "Broaden the email regex to catch plus-addressed users and log the pii.sanitized compliance decision each time."}, "constraints": [{"id": "bug65_email_plus_and_compliance", "voltsnip_key": "voltsnip/script30/hard/bug65/scenario_context/v1", "check": "Plus-addressed email regex fix AND compliance decision via orgops.compliance.record_decision.", "judge_prompt": "Does the implementation both fix the email regex to include + in the local-part character class (so that user+tag@domain.com is redacted) AND call orgops.compliance.record_decision("pii.sanitized", field_count=count) where count is the number of emails redacted?"}]}
